record.field: Grants the "Mark as Paid" / "Not Paid" toggle on approved requests, write access to the request's payment tracking fields (payment_state, payment_date, paid_by_user_id — enforced at the ORM level, not just UI), the "Treasury > To Pay" menu, and eligibility for automatic payment-marking on bank reconciliation.
A bank transaction is assigned to the one waiting approval request it fits, whoever imports the statement or submits the request.
